title: Handshake policy coordinate methods use a different override key than the other handshake paths
reasoning: The top-level handshake and agent-definition paths both emit coordinate capability overrides under agent_available_coordinate_methods, but requested_agent_policy.coordinate_methods emits agent_coordinate_methods. That creates two schema-level names for the same concept, so clients using requested_agent_policy.coordinate_methods can produce an override the session config path may not consume while the equivalent top-level field works.
recommendation: Change HandshakeAgentPolicy.to_session_config_overrides to emit agent_available_coordinate_methods for coordinate_methods, or explicitly support both keys at the config boundary with a migration note if agent_coordinate_methods is already persisted or externally documented.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests are included for this feature, and the mismatch is visible only by comparing sibling schema conversion methods.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a schema/unit test that HandshakeMessage(requested_agent_policy={coordinate_methods:[...]}) produces the same coordinate override key as available_coordinate_methods and AgentDefinition.runtime.coordinate_methods.
minimumFixScope: Update the policy override key and add focused coverage for all coordinate-method handshake paths.
